verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's only first-party background behaviours are condition-triggered rules it runs unattended: frequency-based error alert rules that send email or webhook notifications, and uptime pings or heartbeat checks that alert when a site stops responding. These are fixed monitoring and alerting actions, not general user-defined automations; the MCP server only lets external AI tools act on demand and adds no scheduled or autonomous workflows. missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow rules (e.g., auto-assign, auto-resolve, scheduled jobs), autonomous agent or background-task execution, and independent corroboration of any automation capability.
